title: Bias Vector: Mitigating Biases in Language Models with Task Arithmetic Approach
benchmark_measurement: Measurement of stereotypical bias related to religion using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) to calculate effect sizes in sentence embeddings.
findings: The proposed 'Bias Vector' method reduced religious bias in BERT and RoBERTa models, particularly when religion-specific stereotype data was combined with data from other bias categories (race, gender, profession). Using a religion-only bias vector showed minimal to no improvement, and in one case (ALBERT), a slight increase in bias.
